name: Forgotten (shamble)
notes: The Forgotten (story bible §8): monks and miners who walked into the song, repeating old habits. Human-sized agent (0.35 m, 1.8 m). They shamble: sneak 0.6, walk 0.9, and only a lurching 2.6 m/s run, so a player who is spotted can still walk briskly away. Stiff joints: 0.35 m steps, 35° slopes, they never jump and never climb, so a ladder or a vaulted wall is a real refuge. Bones do not care about falls (they crumble and reassemble, a behaviour, not locomotion), so they step off 6 m drops. They wade to 1.2 m but cannot swim: deep water stops them. They still open doors out of habit (monks walking their old rounds).
